title: Is the sky density of UNCOVER high-z candidates spatially uniform?
question: Do candidate surface-density variations track F444W coverage and lensing structure?
results: The 7x7 occupied-cell depth relation has Spearman rho = 0.42 (p = 0.0125)
validation: The relation is repeated across five grid resolutions and is interpreted only as a selection diagnostic.
provenance: UNCOVER DR3 SUPER catalog, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11059273
limitations: Counts are not corrected by source-plane area or completeness.
A single cluster field cannot establish cosmic clustering.
